title: Proposal for GIC to Re-allocate Some Investments to Securities Listed on Singapore Exchange
what_it_is: Proposal for GIC to Re-allocate Some Investments to Securities Listed on Singapore Exchange

sections.label: GIC long-term investment returns
sections.summary: GIC's investment decisions aim to achieve good long-term returns to enhance the value of Singapore's Reserves.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: First, to enhance the value of Singapore's Reserves, GIC's investment decisions aim to achieve good long-term returns for Singapore.

sections.label: GIC and local equity market
sections.summary: The Government will keep improving the local equity market's attractiveness, but directing GIC to invest in locally listed companies is not the solution.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to find ways to improve the attractiveness of our local equity market, but directing GIC to invest in locally listed companies is not the solution.

sections.label: Funds for growth enterprise IPOs
sections.summary: In 2022 funds like Anchor Fund @ 65 were set up to support growth enterprises and prepare them for IPOs in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: In 2022, we established funds to support growth enterprises and prepare them for Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) here in Singapore when the opportunity arises, such as the Anchor Fund @ 65.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: These funds have invested in nine companies to date and they are working closely with the portfolio companies to prepare them for IPO on the SGX.

sections.label: Growing local equity market
sections.summary: The speaker says they want to look for ways to grow the local equity market.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Indeed, as I mentioned earlier, we do want to look for ways to grow our local equity market.

sections.label: Plans with industry partners
sections.summary: The speaker says there are plans to work with industry partners to see how this can be done.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Indeed, we have plans to work with industry partners to see how we can do this.

sections.label: Local equity market a priority
sections.summary: The speaker says they are working with industry players and that growing the local equity market is an important priority.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I mentioned several times that we are taking a look, working with industry players to see how we can do better.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I mentioned a couple of times that growing the local equity market is an important priority for us.

sections.label: Appropriate and sustainable ways
sections.summary: The speaker says some ways are more appropriate and sustainable, and that levers must be found to achieve that outcome.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Some ways are more appropriate, some ways are more sustainable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I think we need to look for what are those levers that will allow us to achieve that outcome.
